scoring_rule: fractional wins: each tied config at lowest query_error gets 1/n_tied of a win; leaderboard sorted by wins desc then mean_query_error asc
tie_handling: configs are ever_optimal if they appear in the tied-best set for any query
pruning_note: never_optimal_config_ids never appear in the tied-best set for any scored query and are safe to deprioritize in search under the same scoring rule.
